## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive; leadership: Broad (Top 5 from 5 sectors). Confirmation: strong sector breadth counters a MAJOR divergence among Big Tech names (MSFT, GOOGL, META, AMZN showing 1W/1M mismatches), so suppress a strong risk-on call.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Utilities lead: CEG (1W: +10.94% | 1M: +12.05%) ABOVE TREND and SO news supportive. Materials strong: FCX (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples showing strength: MNST (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +6.45%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Industrials lag: Industrials 1W: -0.61% with DE (1W: -6.43% | 1M: +19.31%) in CORRECTION. Technology underperforming on 1M despite small 1W gains: NVDA (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -3.52% | 1M: -24.81%) BELOW TREND. Financials mixed but not leading: MA (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -1.08%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: CEG (1W: +10.94% | 1M: +12.05%) ABOVE TREND, NFLX (1W: +9.86% | 1M: -1.16%) RECOVERY, FCX (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%) ABOVE TREND, PYPL (1W: +9.11% | 1M: -17.98%) RECOVERY, CRM (1W: +7.65% | 1M: -12.72%) RECOVERY — Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: CRH (1W: -3.47% | 1M: -2.05%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -3.52% | 1M: -24.81%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -3.68% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND, LMT (1W: -3.73% | 1M: +7.85%) CORRECTION, ORCL (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -14.06%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select tech/defense names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W movers: CEG (1W: +10.94%), NFLX (1W: +9.86%), FCX (1W: +9.29%), PYPL (1W: +9.11%), CRM (1W: +7.65%); note many high-momentum names are RECOVERY (1W up / 1M down) — tactical moves, not clear trend confirmations.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed; sector 1W positive but 1M weak and several majors BELOW TREND or in RECOVERY. AAPL (1W: +4.75% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: +7.65% | 1M: -12.72%) RECOVERY — watch for trend confirmation.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Mixed but showing pockets of strength; PYPL (1W: +9.11% | 1M: -17.98%) RECOVERY and JPM (1W: -0.62% | 1M: +1.94%) CORRECTION highlight rotation within the group. Broad financials not uniformly leading — monitor MA (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -1.08%) BELOW TREND.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Generally constructive on 1W; LLY (1W: -0.12% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND despite bullish trial news, JNJ (1W: -0.87% | 1M: +9.06%) CORRECTION, PFE (1W: +0.89% | 1M: +2.26%) ABOVE TREND — watch news-driven divergence.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor exposure to Utilities, Materials and selected Staples (CEG, FCX, MNST) given momentum; reduce exposure to tech names showing BELOW TREND (NVDA, ACN, ORCL) and monitor RECOVERY cases for follow-through. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; treat Big Tech divergence as tactical risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: CEG (1W: +10.94% | 1M: +12.05%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +4.75% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ACN (1W: -3.52% | 1M: -24.81%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -3.68% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Utilities (Breadth positive, CEG leadership), Materials (FCX momentum), Consumer Staples (MNST strength). BEARISH: Industrials (1W negative overall), Technology (1M weakness despite 1W bounce) — monitor for trend confirmation.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA 600 resistance (trade remains in BELOW TREND until decisive reclaim), AAPL 180 support (ABOVE TREND hold level), FCX 40 support (ABOVE TREND continuation), JPM 170 breakout would signal renewed cyclical follow-through (CORRECTION to resume uptrend).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
LLY (+80): LLY (1W: -0.12% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND — Phase‑3 win is bullish but price not yet confirming (divergence). FCX (+60): FCX (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%) ABOVE TREND — news confirms price accumulation. MNST (+60): MNST (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +6.45%) ABOVE TREND — earnings beat confirmed by price strength. MA (+55): MA (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -1.08%) BELOW TREND — positive product news but price weak (watch).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
CRM (-50): CRM (1W: +7.65% | 1M: -12.72%) RECOVERY — negative sentiment vs 1W pop is a divergence to monitor. UNH (-50): UNH (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +1.40%) CORRECTION — sentiment aligns with short-term softness. JNJ (-50): JNJ (1W: -0.87% | 1M: +9.06%) CORRECTION — legal headlines increasing risk. HD (-50): HD (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -1.39%) BELOW TREND — negative commentary confirmed by price weakness. XOM (-45): XOM (1W: -1.61% | 1M: +9.28%) CORRECTION — sentiment adds to volatility risk.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership as broad sector breadth (10/11) contrasts with Big Tech divergence. AAPL (1W: +4.75% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND and FCX (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR divergence in Big Tech (MSFT, GOOGL, META, AMZN in RECOVERY/BELOW TREND) and mixed news sentiment (CRM negative vs price up) — watch for trend breaks.
